questions.q: The child will ______ at the strange fish without moving his eyes.
questions.full: The child will stare at the strange fish without moving his eyes.

questions.q: The child will s____ at the strange fish without moving his eyes.
questions.full: The child will stare at the strange fish without moving his eyes.

questions.q: We could silently ______ up at the stars for hours.
questions.full: We could silently gaze up at the stars for hours.

questions.q: We could silently g___ up at the stars for hours.
questions.full: We could silently gaze up at the stars for hours.

questions.q: If you wait here, you may ______ the famous singer through the window.
questions.full: If you wait here, you may glimpse the famous singer through the window.

questions.q: If you wait here, you may g______ the famous singer through the window.
questions.full: If you wait here, you may glimpse the famous singer through the window.

questions.q: Don't ______ through the gift box lid before the party.
questions.full: Don't peek through the gift box lid before the party.

questions.q: Don't p___ through the gift box lid before the party.
questions.full: Don't peek through the gift box lid before the party.

groups.name: empty / vacant / hollow / blank / open
groups.note: empty = 裡面沒有東西;vacant = 沒人占用、可使用;hollow = 內部中空;blank = 表面空白;open = 開放、尚可參與。

groups.name: relatable / relative
groups.note: relatable = 令人有共鳴的;relative = 親戚(n.)、相對的(adj.)。
groups.tip: relatable = relate(感同身受)+ able(能夠);relative 藏著 relation(關係),指有「關係」的人

groups.name: restrain / refrain
groups.note: restrain + 人/情緒 = 約束某人;refrain from + V-ing = 自己克制不做。

groups.name: reply / response
groups.note: reply = 對問題、信件的答覆;response 範圍較廣,也可指行動或生理反應(an immune response)。

groups.name: save / spare
groups.note: save time = 節省時間;spare some time = 抽出一些時間;spare 另有「備用的」。

groups.name: preserve / conserve / reserve / book
groups.note: preserve = 保存原貌;conserve = 節約資源;reserve / book = 預訂(reserve 另有「保留」)。

groups.name: avoid / prevent
groups.note: avoid + V-ing = 避免自己去做;prevent + 人 + from V-ing = 阻止別人去做。

groups.name: packed / crowded / bustling
groups.note: packed = 擠得滿滿的;crowded = 擁擠的(語氣較弱);bustling = 熱鬧忙碌、充滿生氣。

groups.name: suspend / cease / stop / hold / abort
groups.note: suspend = 暫停(可能恢復);cease = 正式的停止;stop = 一般的停止;hold = 暫緩;abort = 在完成前中止。

groups.name: affect / effect
groups.note: affect 是動詞(影響);effect 是名詞(效果、影響),have an effect on = affect。
groups.tip: A = Action(動作 → 動詞);E = End result(結果 → 名詞)

groups.name: accept / except
groups.note: accept = 接受;except = 除了…之外。
groups.tip: accept 的 ac- 有靠近的意思,收進來 = 接受;except 的 ex- 像 exit,被請出去 = 除外

groups.name: adapt / adopt
groups.note: adapt (to) = 適應、改編;adopt = 採用、收養。
groups.tip: adapt 藏著 apt(適合的),變得適合 = 適應;adopt 藏著 opt(選擇),選中 = 採用、收養

groups.name: assume / assure / ensure
groups.note: assume = 假定;assure + 人 = 向某人保證;ensure = 確保。
groups.tip: assume 藏著 me,我自己認為 = 假定;assure 後面接人(I assure you);ensure = en(使)+ sure(確定),確保事情

groups.name: award / reward / aware
groups.note: award = 獎(頒給成就);reward = 酬謝、賞金;aware (of) = 察覺的。
groups.tip: reward 的 re- = 回,回報你;aware 的 -ware 像 beware(小心),留意到 = 察覺

groups.name: complement / compliment
groups.note: complement = 補充、相配;compliment = 稱讚。
groups.tip: complement 的 comple- 像 complete(完整),補上才完整;compliment 的 li 像 lip(嘴唇),用嘴說好話

groups.name: principal / principle
groups.note: principal = 校長、主要的;principle = 原則、原理。
groups.tip: principle 結尾 -le 和 rule 一樣,原則

groups.name: stationary / stationery
groups.note: stationary = 靜止的(adj.);stationery = 文具(n.)。
groups.tip: stationary 的 sta- 有站著的意思,站著不動 = 靜止;stationery 的 e 像 envelope(信封)

groups.name: quiet / quite / quit
groups.note: quiet = 安靜的;quite = 相當、頗;quit = 辭職、放棄。

groups.name: lose / loose
groups.note: lose = 失去、輸(動詞);loose = 鬆的、寬鬆的(形容詞)。
groups.tip: loose 多一個 o,多出空間 = 鬆;lose 少一個 o,少了東西 = 失去

groups.name: personal / personnel
groups.note: personal = 個人的;personnel = 全體人員、人事部門。

groups.name: sensible / sensitive
groups.note: sensible = 明智的、合理的;sensitive = 敏感的、易受傷的。

groups.name: considerate / considerable
groups.note: considerate = 體貼的(對人);considerable = 相當大的、可觀的。

groups.name: raise / rise / arise
groups.note: raise + 受詞(舉起、提高);rise 不接受詞(上升);arise = 出現、產生;三態:rise – rose – risen;raise – raised – raised;arise – arose – arisen。
groups.tip: rise 自己上升;arise = a- + rise,冒出來

groups.name: assemble / resemble
groups.note: assemble = 集合、組裝;resemble = 像、類似(及物,不加 to)。
groups.tip: sembl- 有同樣、一起的意思;assemble 的 as- 是向…靠攏,湊在一起 = 集合;resemble 的 re- 是再一次,再看還是同樣 = 像

groups.name: persist / persevere / insist
groups.note: 都能說成「堅持」,方向不同:persist in = 持續做(可褒可貶,也可指事物持續存在);persevere = 克服困難、堅持到底;insist on = 堅持主張或要求。

groups.name: carry on / keep on / hang on / stick to
groups.note: carry on = 繼續(中斷後);keep on + V-ing = 持續做;hang on = 稍等、撐住;stick to = 堅守(計畫、原則)。

groups.name: crumble / crash / crush
groups.note: crumble = 碎裂、崩塌(慢慢);crash = 撞擊、墜毀、當機;crush = 壓碎、擊潰。

groups.name: steal / rob
groups.note: steal + 東西(偷);rob + 人或地方(搶劫),rob sb. of sth.。

groups.name: lie / lay
groups.note: lie(躺、位於)不接受詞;lay(放置、下蛋)後面要接受詞。另有一個 lie 是「說謊」,三態各不相同:躺 lie – lay – lain – lying;放置 lay – laid – laid – laying;說謊 lie – lied – lied – lying。
groups.tip: lay 後面一定接東西(lay a book);lie 是人自己躺下

groups.name: plain / plane
groups.note: plain = 樸素的、簡單的(也指平原);plane = 飛機、平面。兩字同音。

groups.name: role / roll
groups.note: role = 角色;roll = 滾動、捲(也指圓麵包)。兩字同音。

groups.name: classic / classical
groups.note: classic = 經典的(經得起時間考驗);classical = 古典的(古希臘羅馬或古典時期的風格)。

groups.name: waste / waist
groups.note: waste = 浪費、廢棄物;waist = 腰。兩字同音。

groups.name: abroad / aboard / broad
groups.note: abroad 是副詞,不加 in / to(go abroad);aboard = 在船、車、飛機上;broad = 寬闊的(形容詞)。
groups.tip: aboard 裡有 board(登上交通工具);broad 與 wide 同義

groups.name: beside / besides
groups.note: beside = 在…旁邊(= next to);besides = 除…之外還有、此外。
groups.tip: besides 多一個 s = 多了一些東西(額外)

groups.name: cloth / clothes / clothe
groups.note: cloth = 布料;clothes = 衣服(只有複數);clothe = 給…穿衣(動詞,常用 be clothed in)。

groups.name: later / latter / lately / latest
groups.note: later = 較晚、稍後;latter = 後者(與 former 前者相對);lately = 最近(常配現在完成式);latest = 最新的。

groups.name: diary / dairy / daily
groups.note: diary = 日記;dairy = 乳製品(dairy products);daily = 每日的。
groups.tip: diary 與 day 有關(每天寫);dairy 與牛奶有關(dairy farm);daily = day + ly

groups.name: poll / pole / pool
groups.note: poll = 民意調查;pole = 桿子、地球的極;pool = 水池。

groups.name: through / thorough / throughout
groups.note: through = 穿過、經由;thorough = 徹底的、周密的;throughout = 自始至終、遍及各處。

groups.name: historic / historical
groups.note: historic = 在歷史上有重大意義的(a historic moment);historical = 與歷史有關的(a historical novel)。

groups.name: scarce / scare
groups.note: scarce = 稀少的、缺乏的(形容詞);scare = 驚嚇(動詞)。

groups.name: trail / trial
groups.note: trail = 小徑、足跡;trial = 審判、試驗。

groups.name: wander / wonder
groups.note: wander = 漫步、閒逛;wonder = 想知道(動詞),也指驚奇(名詞)。
groups.tip: wander 的 a 唸 /ɑ/(走來走去);wonder 的 o 唸 /ʌ/

groups.name: medal / metal / mental
groups.note: 三個字長得很像,各差一個字母:medal = 獎牌;metal = 金屬;mental = 心理的。

groups.name: desert / dessert / deserve
groups.note: desert 當名詞唸 /ˈdɛzɚt/ = 沙漠;當動詞唸 /dɪˈzɝt/ = 遺棄;dessert 唸 /dɪˈzɝt/ = 甜點;deserve = 應得。
groups.tip: dessert 有兩個 s = 想再吃一份甜點(sweet);desert 一個 s,沙漠裡什麼都沒有

groups.name: propose / suppose / oppose / expose / impose / compose / pose
groups.note: -pose 是「放」。靠詞首辨認:pro-(向前)= 提出;sup-(下)= 假定;op-(對著)= 反對;ex-(外)= 暴露;im-(加上)= 強加;com-(一起)= 組成;pose = 擺姿勢。

groups.name: resist / insist / assist / persist
groups.note: -sist 家族,意思完全不同:resist = 抵抗、忍住不(擋回去);insist = 堅持要求(推出去);assist = 協助;persist = 持續、堅持下去。常被拼成 ressist(多打一個 s)。

groups.name: site / sight / cite
groups.note: 三字同音:site = 地點、網站;sight = 視力、景象;cite = 引用。

groups.name: sustain / maintain / retain / contain / obtain
groups.note: -tain(握住)家族,靠前綴分:sus-(從下撐住)= 維持、支撐,也指承受(傷害、損失);main-(用手握)= 維持、保養;re-(留住)= 保留;con-(包住)= 包含;ob-(取得)= 獲得。

groups.name: conscious / conscience
groups.note: conscious 是形容詞(be conscious of = 意識到、清醒的);conscience 是名詞(良心,a guilty conscience)。
groups.tip: conscience 結尾像 science(名詞);conscious 結尾 -ous 是形容詞

groups.name: recipe / receipt
groups.note: recipe /ˈrɛsəpi/ = 食譜;receipt /rɪˈsit/ = 收據,p 不發音。

groups.name: confident / confidential
groups.note: confident 形容人有自信;confidential 形容資料、訊息屬機密。

groups.name: steak / stake
groups.note: steak = 牛排;stake = 賭注、利害關係(at stake = 攸關、危在旦夕)。兩字同音。

groups.name: lesson / lessen
groups.note: lesson = 課、教訓;lessen = 減少、減輕。兩字同音。

groups.name: scenery / scene / scent
groups.note: scenery = 風景(不可數,不加 a);scene = 場景、現場(可數);scent = 氣味(c 不發音)。

groups.name: refuse / refuge / refund / refugee
groups.note: refuse = 拒絕(動詞);refuge = 避難所、庇護;refund = 退款;refugee = 難民(來到避難處的人)。

groups.name: cease / seize
groups.note: cease = 停止、結束(正式);seize = 突然抓住、奪取、扣押。

groups.name: context / contest / content
groups.note: context = 上下文、背景;contest = 比賽;content = 內容(名詞,重音在前),也可當形容詞「滿足的」(重音在後)。

groups.name: device / devise
groups.note: device = 裝置(名詞);devise = 設計、想出(動詞,devise a plan)。
groups.tip: device 結尾 -ice(名詞,像 office);devise 結尾 -ise(動詞,像 advise)

groups.name: economic / economical
groups.note: economic 和「經濟」(economy)有關;economical 指花費少、省錢、有效率。

groups.name: genius / genuine
groups.note: genius /ˈdʒinjəs/ = 天才;genuine /ˈdʒɛnjuɪn/ = 真正的、非假的、誠懇的。

groups.name: imaginary / imaginative
groups.note: imaginary = 想像出來的、不存在的;imaginative = 富有想像力的。

groups.name: intense / intensive
groups.note: intense = 強烈的、劇烈的(形容強度);intensive = 密集的、加強的(形容密度、投入程度)。

groups.name: alley / ally
groups.note: alley /ˈæli/ = 巷弄;ally /ˈælaɪ/ = 盟友、同盟國。

groups.name: prospect / perspective / respect / aspect
groups.note: prospect = 對未來的展望、前景;perspective = 看事情的角度、觀點;respect = 尊敬(也指「方面」);aspect = 方面。
groups.tip: -spect 與「看」有關:prospect 往前看(前景)、perspective 透過看(角度)、aspect 看過去的那一面

groups.name: quote / quota
groups.note: quote = 引用(別人的話)、報價;quota = 規定的配額、名額。

groups.name: accustom / costume / custom
groups.note: accustom = 使習慣(be accustomed to + N / V-ing);costume = 服裝、戲服;custom = 習俗、習慣。

groups.name: breath / breathe / breadth
groups.note: breath /brɛθ/ = 呼吸、氣息(名詞);breathe /brið/ = 呼吸(動詞);breadth /brɛdθ/ = 寬度。
groups.tip: breathe 多一個 e,是動詞,唸有聲的 /ð/

groups.name: cereal / serial
groups.note: 兩字同音 /ˈsɪriəl/:cereal = 穀片、穀類食品;serial = 連續的、系列的(serial number 序號)。

groups.name: perceive / conceive / deceive / receive
groups.note: 都拼成 -ceive(i before e, except after c:發 /i/ 音、前面是 c 時,e 在 i 前)。perceive = 察覺、認為;conceive = 構想、懷孕;deceive = 欺騙;receive = 收到。

groups.name: precede / proceed / process
groups.note: precede = 在…之前(pre- 之前);proceed = 繼續進行、前往(proceed to / with);process = 過程;處理。

groups.name: alternate / alternative
groups.note: alternate = 輪流的、交替(on alternate days = 隔天);alternative = 可替代的、另一個選擇。美式英文 alternate route 也常用,題目已避開。

groups.name: council / counsel
groups.note: council = 議會、委員會(機構);counsel = 忠告、輔導(counselor 輔導老師)。

groups.name: moral / morale
groups.note: moral /ˈmɔrəl/ = 道德的;寓意;morale /məˈræl/ = 士氣(名詞,重音在後)。

groups.name: respectful / respectable / respective
groups.note: respectful = 對人有禮貌、表示尊敬;respectable = 值得尊敬的、體面的;respective = 各自的(一定放在複數名詞前,their respective jobs)。

groups.name: cooperate / corporate / coordinate / incorporate
groups.note: cooperate = 合作(co- 一起 + operate);corporate = 企業的、公司的;coordinate = 協調;incorporate = 把…併入。

groups.name: attitude / altitude / latitude / gratitude
groups.note: -itude 家族,靠詞首辨認:att- = 態度;alt-(高)= 海拔;lat-(寬)= 緯度;grat-(感謝)= 感激。

groups.name: confine / confide
groups.note: 兩字只差一個字母:confine = 限制在、禁閉(confine A to B);confide = 吐露(祕密)、信任(confide in sb.)。

groups.name: access / excess
groups.note: access = 接近(的權利)、使用權,也可當動詞「存取」(access to + N);excess = 超過的量、過度(excess baggage)。

groups.name: emigrate / immigrate
groups.note: emigrate = 移出(從原居地離開,e- 往外 + from);immigrate = 移入(遷入他國,im- 往內 + into / to)。
groups.tip: emigrate 的 e = exit(出去);immigrate 的 im = in(進來)

groups.name: fiction / friction
groups.note: fiction = 虛構作品、小說;friction = 摩擦、衝突。

groups.name: intimate / intimidate
groups.note: intimate /ˈɪntəmɪt/ = 親密的(形容詞);intimidate /ɪnˈtɪmɪdeɪt/ = 恐嚇、使膽怯(動詞)。

groups.name: statue / statute / stature
groups.note: statue = 雕像;statute = 成文法、法規;stature = 身材、聲望。

groups.name: literal / literary / literate
groups.note: literal = 字面上的;literary = 文學的;literate = 識字的、有讀寫能力的(反義 illiterate)。

groups.name: decent / descent
groups.note: decent /ˈdisənt/ = 像樣的、得體的;descent /dɪˈsɛnt/ = 下降、血統(descend 的名詞)。

groups.name: explicit / implicit
groups.note: explicit = 明確的、說得清楚明白的;implicit = 暗示的、隱含的(沒說出口)。

groups.name: suppress / surpass / oppress / depress
groups.note: suppress(sup- 往下壓)= 抑制、鎮壓;surpass(sur- 超過)= 超越、勝過;oppress = 壓迫(人民);depress = 使沮喪。

groups.name: solitary / solitude / solidity
groups.note: solitary = 獨自一人的(形容詞);solitude = 獨處、孤獨(名詞,可以是享受的獨處);solidity = 堅固、穩固(名詞)。

groups.name: price / cost / expense / value / worth
groups.note: price = 標價(price tag);cost = 付出的成本、代價;expense = 開銷、花費;value = 價值;worth + 金額 / V-ing(值得)。

groups.name: lonely / alone / lone
groups.note: lonely = 覺得寂寞(感受);alone = 獨自、沒有別人在身邊;lone 只放名詞前(a lone traveler = 唯一的、孤單的)。

groups.name: consider / regard / view / treat
groups.note: consider A (as) B;regard A as B;view A as B;treat A as B(對待,不是「認為」)。

groups.name: main / chief / major / primary
groups.note: main = 主要的(最常用);chief = 地位最高的(chief editor);major = 較大、較重要的;primary = 第一位、最初的(primary school)。

groups.name: bring / take / fetch / carry / deliver
groups.note: bring(帶到說話者這邊);take(帶離說話者);fetch(去拿來);carry(攜帶、搬運,不管方向);deliver(遞送到)。

groups.name: method / way / manner / means / approach / technique / measure
groups.note: method(有系統的方法);way(一般的方式);manner(態度、方式);means(手段,單複數同形);approach(處理方式);technique(技術、技巧);measure(措施)。

groups.name: quality / quantity / amount / number / figure / sum
groups.note: quality(質);quantity(量);amount + 不可數名詞;number + 可數名詞;figure(數據、人物);sum(總和、金額)。

groups.name: hope / wish / expect / anticipate / look forward to
groups.note: hope(有可能實現);wish(多與事實相反);expect(預期會發生);anticipate(預料並預作準備);look forward to 的 to 是介系詞,後面接 V-ing。

members.zh: 期待(to 是介系詞,+ V-ing)

groups.name: chance / opportunity / occasion / possibility
groups.note: chance(偶然的機會);opportunity(有利的時機);occasion(特定場合);possibility(可能性)。

groups.name: wage / salary / income / pay
groups.note: wage 依工時計算;salary 固定月薪;income 是總收入;pay 泛指薪資或支付。

groups.name: attend / participate / accompany / join
groups.note: attend + N(不加 in);participate in(參與);accompany sb.(陪同);join(加入)。

groups.name: fast / quick / rapid / swift / prompt
groups.note: fast(速度快);quick(短時間完成);rapid(變化、成長快);swift(敏捷,文學味);prompt(立即、準時)。

groups.name: rule / law / regulation / principle
groups.note: rule(一般規則);law(法律);regulation(官方規章);principle(行事或思考的原則)。

groups.name: cheap / reasonable / costly
groups.note: cheap(便宜,有時帶「廉價」的貶意);reasonable(價格合理);costly(代價大、昂貴)。

groups.name: happen / occur / arise
groups.note: happen / occur 皆指事件發生;happen to + V(碰巧)、occur to sb.(想到);arise(浮現、產生,常 arise from)。

groups.name: offer / provide / supply / furnish / afford / present
groups.note: offer(主動提供);provide sb. with sth.;supply(持續供給);furnish(配備、裝設家具);afford(負擔得起);present(贈送、呈現)。

groups.name: custom / habit / tradition / convention / routine
groups.note: custom(社會習俗);habit(個人習慣);tradition(代代相傳);convention(約定俗成);routine(日常固定程序)。

groups.name: choose / select / pick / elect / opt
groups.note: choose(一般選擇);select(慎重挑選);pick(隨手挑);elect(票選);opt for(選用)。

groups.name: whole / entire / total / complete / intact
groups.note: whole(完整的一個);entire(強調沒有遺漏);total(合計的);complete(齊全、完成);intact(完好無損)。

groups.name: decide / determine / resolve / conclude
groups.note: decide(決定);determine(下定決心、判定);resolve(下決心或解決問題);conclude(推論出結論)。

groups.name: heal / cure / treat / remedy
groups.note: heal(傷口、心靈痊癒);cure(治好疾病);treat(診療、處理);remedy(補救辦法、療法)。

groups.name: possess / own / occupy / hold
groups.note: possess(正式,擁有,也用於特質);own(自己名下擁有);occupy(佔據、佔用);hold(握著、持有)。

groups.name: build / construct / establish / found / form
groups.note: build(一般建造);construct(較正式,大型建設);establish(建立制度、關係);found(創辦機構);form(形成)。

groups.name: customer / client / guest / passenger / consumer / visitor / tourist
groups.note: customer(買東西的人);client(接受專業服務的客戶);guest(受邀或住宿的客人);passenger(乘客);consumer(消費者、使用者);visitor(來訪者);tourist(觀光客)。

groups.name: join / connect / link / attach / unite
groups.note: join(加入、把兩者合在一起);connect(把兩處接起來);link(關聯、連結);attach(附上、貼上);unite(團結、合而為一)。

groups.name: elder / elderly / senior
groups.note: elder(同輩中較年長,my elder brother);elderly(上了年紀的,較委婉);senior(職位、年級較高)。

groups.name: aim / goal / purpose / target / objective / intention
groups.note: aim(瞄準的目標);goal(想達成的終點);purpose(目的,on purpose = 故意);target(對象、靶);objective(具體目標,也指客觀的);intention(意圖,no intention of V-ing)。

groups.name: clear / obvious / apparent / evident / vivid
groups.note: clear(清楚、透明);obvious(誰都看得出);apparent(看起來如此,apparently);evident(有證據顯示);vivid(畫面、記憶鮮明)。

groups.name: fix / repair / mend / restore / renovate
groups.note: 修理、恢復原狀,對象多半是實物或關係。fix(口語,通用);repair(機械、建物);mend(衣物、關係的修補);restore(使恢復原狀);renovate(翻修舊建築)。

groups.name: job / work / career / occupation / profession / task / chore / affair
groups.note: job 可數;work 不可數;career(長期職涯);occupation(填表的職業);profession(醫師、律師等需專業訓練);task(分派的任務);chore(家務、雜事);affair(事務、事件)。

groups.name: pain / ache / hurt / suffer / agony
groups.note: pain(一般的痛);ache(隱隱作痛、持續的痛);hurt(受傷、感到痛);suffer from(受苦於);agony(劇痛、極度痛苦)。

groups.name: permit / allow / let / authorize / admit / grant
groups.note: permit(正式許可;許可證);allow(一般允許);let 後面接原形動詞;authorize(授權);admit(承認;准許進入);grant(賜予、准予)。

groups.name: reject / refuse / deny / decline
groups.note: reject(駁回、拒絕接受);refuse(不肯,refuse to V);deny(否認);decline(禮貌婉拒;下降)。

groups.name: trip / journey / tour / travel / voyage / commute
groups.note: trip(短途、一來一回);journey(長途旅程);tour(觀光旅行);travel(旅行,動詞或不可數名詞);voyage(航海);commute(通勤)。

groups.name: injure / harm / damage / hurt / wound / spoil / destroy / ruin / wreck
groups.note: 對人:injure(使受傷)、harm(傷害)、hurt(傷害;痛)、wound(槍或刀傷)。對物:damage(損壞)、spoil(寵壞;毀掉)、destroy(徹底摧毀)、ruin(毀掉)、wreck(使失事、搞砸)。

groups.name: fee / fare / fine / charge / rent / toll / tuition
groups.note: fee(服務、入場費);fare(搭車的車資);fine(罰款);charge(收取的費用);rent(租金);toll(過路費);tuition(學費)。

groups.name: notice / observe / realize / recognize / identify / spot / acknowledge
groups.note: notice(留意到);observe(仔細觀察);realize(領悟、意識到);recognize(認出);identify(辨認身分);spot(瞥見、發現);acknowledge(承認;致謝)。

groups.name: accuse / criticize / blame / charge
groups.note: accuse sb. of;criticize sb. for;blame sb. for / blame sth. on sb.;charge sb. with。

groups.name: alarm / alert / warn
groups.note: alarm(警報器);alert(警覺的、警示);warn(警告)。

groups.name: result / outcome / consequence / effect
groups.note: result(一般結果,as a result of);outcome(最終結果);consequence(多為不良後果);effect(影響,effect on)。

groups.name: cause / trigger / contribute / lead
groups.note: cause + N(造成);trigger(引爆、觸發);contribute to + N(促成);lead to + N(導致),lead 也指帶領。

groups.name: emphasize / stress / highlight
groups.note: emphasize(強調);stress(強調、重音、壓力);highlight(突顯、劃重點)。

groups.name: lack / shortage / absence
groups.note: lack(缺少,lack of);shortage(供不應求的短缺);absence(不在、缺席)。

groups.name: landscape / scenery / scene / view / sight / vision / insight
groups.note: landscape(陸地風景);scenery(整體景色,不可數);scene(場景、現場);view(看到的景);sight(看見的東西,at the sight of);vision(視力、遠見);insight(看穿事物本質的洞察力,抽象)。

groups.name: show / display / exhibit / demonstrate / reveal / indicate / manifest
groups.note: show(一般);display(擺出);exhibit(展覽);demonstrate(實際演示);reveal(揭露祕密);indicate(指出、表明);manifest(顯示出,較正式)。

groups.name: silly / foolish / ridiculous / absurd / stupid
groups.note: silly(孩子氣、好笑);foolish(缺乏判斷力的愚蠢);ridiculous(荒謬可笑);absurd(不合理);stupid(笨)。

groups.name: mistake / error / fault / flaw / defect / blame
groups.note: mistake(日常的錯誤,by mistake);error(正式、技術性的錯誤);fault(該負責的過錯);flaw(小瑕疵);defect(缺陷);blame(責怪)。

groups.name: require / demand / request / ask / claim / inquire
groups.note: require(規定需要);demand(強硬要求);request(客氣、正式請求);ask(問;要求);claim(主張;索取);inquire(詢問,inquire about)。

groups.name: argue / debate / quarrel / dispute / bargain
groups.note: argue(說理爭論);debate(正式辯論);quarrel(吵架);dispute(爭議);bargain(討價還價)。

groups.name: fear / dread / terror / horror / panic
groups.note: fear(一般的恐懼);dread(對未來的懼怕);terror(極度驚恐);horror(驚嚇、反感,to one's horror);panic(慌亂)。

groups.name: begin / start / launch / initiate / resume
groups.note: begin 與 start 常通用;start 也可指啟動機器;launch(發射、推出產品);initiate(正式發起);resume(中斷後再開始)。

groups.name: contain / include / involve / comprise
groups.note: contain(內含);include(包括,不一定全部);involve(涉及、牽涉);comprise(由…組成)。

groups.name: enough / sufficient / adequate / ample
groups.note: enough(一般,可放形容詞後);sufficient(正式的足夠);adequate(剛好夠用、合格);ample(綽綽有餘)。

groups.name: protect / defend / guard / shield
groups.note: protect(使免受傷害);defend(抵禦攻擊);guard(看守);shield(遮擋)。

groups.name: suggest / propose / recommend / advise / urge
groups.note: suggest / propose / recommend 後可接 that + S + (should) V;advise sb. to V;urge sb. to V;propose 也有「求婚」的意思。

groups.name: gain / earn / win / obtain / acquire / attain
groups.note: gain(獲得好處、體重、經驗);earn(靠努力賺);win(贏得比賽、獎項);obtain(正式取得);acquire(逐漸習得);attain(達成目標)。

groups.name: separate / divide / part / disconnect / detach
groups.note: separate(使分離);divide(分成幾份);part(分開、離別,part from);disconnect(切斷連接);detach(拆下、使分離)。

groups.name: ignore / neglect / overlook
groups.note: ignore(刻意不理);neglect(疏忽應做的事);overlook(沒看見;或「眺望」)。

groups.name: ability / capacity / capability / skill / talent / competence
groups.note: ability(一般能力);capacity(容量、潛能);capability(具備的能力);skill(練成的技能);talent(天賦);competence(勝任的能力)。

groups.name: policy / strategy / tactic
groups.note: policy(組織或政府的方針);strategy(為達成目標的整體策略);tactic(strategy 底下的具體手段,常用複數 tactics)。

groups.name: real / actual / genuine / authentic / virtual / realistic
groups.note: real(真的);actual(實際的);genuine(真誠的、非偽造的);authentic(原汁原味、可信);virtual(虛擬的);realistic(現實的、務實的)。

groups.name: strange / odd / peculiar / weird / curious / extraordinary
groups.note: strange(陌生、奇怪);odd(不尋常,也指奇數);peculiar(獨特,peculiar to = 特有於);weird(令人毛骨悚然的怪);curious(好奇的);extraordinary(非凡的)。

groups.name: borrow / lend / loan / lease / rent / mortgage
groups.note: borrow 向人借;lend 借給人;loan(貸款);lease(長期租約);rent(租用);mortgage(抵押貸款)。

groups.name: evidence / proof / witness / clue / trace
groups.note: evidence(證據,不可數);proof(證明);witness(證人、目擊者);clue(線索);trace(蹤跡)。

groups.name: ancient / antique / primitive / modern / contemporary
groups.note: ancient(遠古的);antique(古董的);primitive(原始的);modern(現代的);contemporary(同時代的、當代的)。

groups.name: forbid / prohibit / ban / bar / block
groups.note: forbid sb. to V;prohibit sb. from V-ing;ban(官方禁令);bar(擋在門外);block(阻塞)。

groups.name: mix / blend / combine / stir / mingle
groups.note: mix(泛稱混合,mix up = 弄混);blend(調和成一體,blend in);combine(結合);stir(用工具攪動);mingle(混在人群裡交際)。

groups.name: pretend / fake / imitate / mimic / copy
groups.note: pretend(假裝);fake(偽造的、假的);imitate(模仿);mimic(惟妙惟肖地學);copy(複製、抄襲)。

groups.name: increase / expand / extend / enlarge
groups.note: increase(數量增加);expand(範圍擴大);extend(延長、延伸);enlarge(放大尺寸)。

groups.name: break / crack / split / burst / shatter / smash
groups.note: break(最泛用);crack(出現裂縫);split(沿長線裂開);burst(爆開);shatter(碎成片);smash(猛力砸碎)。

groups.name: declare / announce / proclaim / claim
groups.note: declare(正式宣告);announce(對外公布);proclaim(公開宣示);claim(聲稱;認領、索取)。

groups.name: judge / evaluate / assess / estimate / rate
groups.note: judge(判斷);evaluate(評價優劣);assess(評定數量、價值);estimate(概算);rate(評等)。

groups.name: bother / disturb / interrupt / interfere / annoy / disrupt
groups.note: bother(煩擾);disturb(打擾寧靜);interrupt(打斷);interfere in / with(干預);annoy(使惱怒);disrupt(擾亂、使中斷)。

groups.name: envy / jealous / envious
groups.note: envy(羨慕他人所擁有,可當動詞或名詞);jealous(嫉妒,擔心被奪走所愛);envious(羨慕的)。

groups.name: change / alter / shift / switch / convert / transform / modify / vary / revise / amend
groups.note: 改變、修改,對象多半是內容、計畫、文件。change(通用);alter(小幅更改);shift(轉移);switch(切換);convert(轉成另一形態);transform(徹底改觀);modify(調整);vary(變動);revise(修訂文稿、計畫);amend(修正法條、文件)。

groups.name: harsh / severe / strict / rigid
groups.note: harsh(天氣、批評、處罰的嚴酷);severe(程度嚴重、處分嚴厲);strict(人或規定的嚴格);rigid(不知變通、僵硬)。

groups.name: motivate / inspire / encourage / stimulate
groups.note: motivate(給人動機、誘因,如獎金);inspire(激發靈感,inspire sb. with sth.);encourage(給人勇氣、鼓勵);stimulate(刺激、使活躍)。

groups.name: danger / risk / hazard / peril / threat
groups.note: danger(一般的危險);risk(冒險、風險);hazard(潛在的危害物);peril(嚴重的危險);threat(威脅)。

groups.name: improve / enhance / upgrade / boost / promote / advance
groups.note: improve(變好);enhance(提高品質);upgrade(升級);boost(推升);promote(提倡、促進;升遷);advance(前進)。

groups.name: weak / fragile / delicate / feeble / frail
groups.note: weak(力量弱);fragile(易碎);delicate(精細易損、需要技巧);feeble(衰弱無力);frail(年老或生病而虛弱)。

groups.name: tool / instrument / equipment / appliance / utensil / facility / infrastructure
groups.note: tool(手工具);instrument(精密儀器、樂器);equipment(整套設備,不可數);appliance(家電);utensil(廚房或餐具);facility(設施);infrastructure(基礎建設)。

groups.name: likely / apt / prone
groups.note: likely to V(可能);apt to V(習慣上容易);apt 也可指「適當的、貼切的」(an apt reply);prone to + N / V-ing(容易受…影響,多指不好的事)。

groups.name: reduce / decrease / shrink / lessen / diminish
groups.note: reduce(使減少);decrease(量自行減少);shrink(縮水、縮小);lessen(減輕);diminish(逐漸變少)。

groups.name: compose / comprise / consist / constitute
groups.note: be composed of = consist of = comprise;constitute = 構成整體的一部分。注意主詞方向:全體 comprises 部分;部分 constitute 全體。

groups.name: force / compel / oblige / urge / prompt
groups.note: force sb. to V(以武力或強大壓力強迫,違背對方意願);compel sb. to V(較正式,因法律、規定或情勢而不得不,不一定用暴力);oblige(責成、使不得不);urge sb. to V(力勸);prompt(促使、引起)。

groups.name: praise / applaud / acclaim / admire
groups.note: 稱讚與欽佩。praise(一般稱讚);applaud(公開喝采、鼓掌);acclaim(公開盛讚);admire(內心佩服,不一定說出口)。

groups.name: vague / ambiguous / obscure / blur
groups.note: vague(不明確);ambiguous(可有兩種以上解讀);obscure(難懂、不出名);blur(模糊)。

groups.name: successive / consecutive
groups.note: 兩字都指「一個接著一個」,文法上常可互換,差別在慣用搭配:consecutive 強調中間沒有間隔,最常見的搭配是 consecutive numbers(連號)、consecutive days / games(連續幾天、幾場);successive 強調依序相繼出現,最常見的是 successive generations / governments(歷代、歷屆)。

groups.name: exceed / surpass / excel
groups.note: exceed + 數量/期望(exceed the speed limit);surpass + 人/紀錄(surpass one's rival);excel in / at + N(不接受詞,表示出色)。

questions.note: empty = 裡面沒有東西;vacant = 沒人占用、可使用;hollow = 內部中空;blank = 表面空白;open = 開放、尚可參與。
questions.q: The glass is ______, so please fill it with water.
questions.full: The glass is empty, so please fill it with water.

questions.note: empty = 裡面沒有東西;vacant = 沒人占用、可使用;hollow = 內部中空;blank = 表面空白;open = 開放、尚可參與。
questions.q: The hospital has no ______ beds tonight.
questions.full: The hospital has no vacant beds tonight.

questions.note: empty = 裡面沒有東西;vacant = 沒人占用、可使用;hollow = 內部中空;blank = 表面空白;open = 開放、尚可參與。
questions.q: The old tree trunk is ______ inside, and a family of owls lives there.
questions.full: The old tree trunk is hollow inside, and a family of owls lives there.

questions.note: empty = 裡面沒有東西;vacant = 沒人占用、可使用;hollow = 內部中空;blank = 表面空白;open = 開放、尚可參與。
questions.q: Please leave this page ______ so I can draw on it.
questions.full: Please leave this page blank so I can draw on it.

questions.note: empty = 裡面沒有東西;vacant = 沒人占用、可使用;hollow = 內部中空;blank = 表面空白;open = 開放、尚可參與。
questions.q: Applications are still ______, so you can apply until Friday.
questions.full: Applications are still open, so you can apply until Friday.

questions.note: relatable = 令人有共鳴的;relative = 親戚(n.)、相對的(adj.)。
questions.tip: relatable = relate(感同身受)+ able(能夠);relative 藏著 relation(關係),指有「關係」的人
questions.q: That video about being tired all the time was so ______.
questions.full: That video about being tired all the time was so relatable.

questions.note: relatable = 令人有共鳴的;relative = 親戚(n.)、相對的(adj.)。
questions.tip: relatable = relate(感同身受)+ able(能夠);relative 藏著 relation(關係),指有「關係」的人
questions.q: We visited our ______ in Taichung last weekend.
questions.full: We visited our relative in Taichung last weekend.

questions.note: relatable = 令人有共鳴的;relative = 親戚(n.)、相對的(adj.)。
questions.tip: relatable = relate(感同身受)+ able(能夠);relative 藏著 relation(關係),指有「關係」的人
questions.q: The cost is low ______ to our income.
questions.full: The cost is low relative to our income.

questions.note: relatable = 令人有共鳴的;relative = 親戚(n.)、相對的(adj.)。
questions.tip: relatable = relate(感同身受)+ able(能夠);relative 藏著 relation(關係),指有「關係」的人
questions.q: Many students find the main character very ______ because they feel the same pressure.
questions.full: Many students find the main character very relatable because they feel the same pressure.

questions.note: restrain + 人/情緒 = 約束某人;refrain from + V-ing = 自己克制不做。
questions.q: He managed to ______ his anger in front of the customers.
questions.full: He managed to restrain his anger in front of the customers.

questions.note: restrain + 人/情緒 = 約束某人;refrain from + V-ing = 自己克制不做。
questions.q: Please ______ from smoking in this building.
questions.full: Please refrain from smoking in this building.

questions.note: restrain + 人/情緒 = 約束某人;refrain from + V-ing = 自己克制不做。
questions.q: The security guards had to ______ the angry man.
questions.full: The security guards had to restrain the angry man.

questions.note: restrain + 人/情緒 = 約束某人;refrain from + V-ing = 自己克制不做。
questions.q: Visitors should ______ from touching the paintings.
questions.full: Visitors should refrain from touching the paintings.

questions.note: reply = 對問題、信件的答覆;response 範圍較廣,也可指行動或生理反應(an immune response)。
questions.q: I sent her an email last week, but I haven't received a ______ yet.
questions.full: I sent her an email last week, but I haven't received a reply yet.

questions.note: reply = 對問題、信件的答覆;response 範圍較廣,也可指行動或生理反應(an immune response)。
questions.q: The body's immune ______ helps fight the virus.
questions.full: The body's immune response helps fight the virus.

questions.note: reply = 對問題、信件的答覆;response 範圍較廣,也可指行動或生理反應(an immune response)。
questions.q: The city's quick ______ to the flood saved many lives.
questions.full: The city's quick response to the flood saved many lives.

questions.note: reply = 對問題、信件的答覆;response 範圍較廣,也可指行動或生理反應(an immune response)。
questions.q: Please ______ to my message as soon as you can.
questions.full: Please reply to my message as soon as you can.

questions.note: save time = 節省時間;spare some time = 抽出一些時間;spare 另有「備用的」。
questions.q: Taking the shortcut will ______ us twenty minutes.
questions.full: Taking the shortcut will save us twenty minutes.

questions.note: save time = 節省時間;spare some time = 抽出一些時間;spare 另有「備用的」。
questions.q: Do you have a ______ key in case I lose mine?
questions.full: Do you have a spare key in case I lose mine?

questions.note: save time = 節省時間;spare some time = 抽出一些時間;spare 另有「備用的」。
questions.q: Can you ______ me a few minutes to talk about my project?
questions.full: Can you spare me a few minutes to talk about my project?

questions.note: save time = 節省時間;spare some time = 抽出一些時間;spare 另有「備用的」。
questions.q: The firefighter risked his life to ______ the child.
questions.full: The firefighter risked his life to save the child.

questions.note: preserve = 保存原貌;conserve = 節約資源;reserve / book = 預訂(reserve 另有「保留」)。

questions.note: 兩字都指「一個接著一個」,文法上常可互換,差別在慣用搭配:consecutive 強調中間沒有間隔,最常見的搭配是 consecutive numbers(連號)、consecutive days / games(連續幾天、幾場);successive 強調依序相繼出現,最常見的是 successive generations / governments(歷代、歷屆)。
